title: PredR
tagline: A ranking-based prediction market on attention assets, starting from a influencer reputation system
description:
The attention economy significantly influences traders' behavior, with influencers playing a key role in spreading information. However, there’s a lack of reliable sources to identify which influencers provide high-value insights for investments.

Kaito offers a useful feature but focuses on projects and ranks Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) based on visibility rather than the quality of their insights (Alpha). We’ve created a prediction market to help users distinguish between KOLs sharing credible information and those merely seeking to boost their own traffic with low-value content.

As a news platform, it informs users about KOLs’ daily performance, expected reputation, and which KOLs’ insights are worth following. As a trading platform, it allows users to predict the daily KOL leaderboard, similar to horse racing, and earn rewards for accurate predictions.
how_its_made:
We used Privy + Phentom wallets, Google cloud as computation infra, supporting both EVM and Solana smart contracts, React + TypeScript + Vite as frontend, and the public twitter API + Dexscreener to download the KOL related information. 

Privy helps us get the information about the user twitter once loggin, help us generate a reputation card for users to share on the internet.
